scope: Disposable two-region GslbDns local-probe DNS-over-TCP soak; not a production availability test.

environment.clientPath: SSH local TCP port forwards; no public DNS listener
environment.backends: Existing Apache HTTP origins; both returned HTTP 200 before the run
environment.globalization: DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 for the ASCII-only disposable test zone

limitations: This run used local HTTP health probes; it did not exercise signed asynchronous agent reports.
The SSH-forwarded DNS query RTT includes WSL, public SSH transport and the client path; it is not public-recursive-resolver or end-user DNS latency.
This was one 10-minute run, not the required 60-minute per-node physical soak or matched capacity test.
It does not validate authoritative delegation, DNSSEC, GeoIP/ECS, inter-authoritative-node fencing, VRRP/ECMP or 99.9% availability.

A prior 10-minute run with asynchronous observer report tunnels recorded one query timeout at the same client deadline. This clean repeat used a different local-probe configuration and does not establish that timeout's root cause.
